F-PROD-01-1.description: Landing plan table and /pricing disagree on downloads.
F-PROD-01-1.expected: One download policy on every surface.
F-PROD-01-1.actual: Landing table row 'Downloads / month' shows 5 GB / 100 GB / 1 TB; /pricing says 'Downloads not charged' on all plans and 'Extra GB downloaded: Not charged'.
F-PROD-01-1.evidence: Landing snapshot rows 'Downloads / month' [cells 5 GB,100 GB,1 TB]; /pricing text 'Downloads not charged'; /Users/dennison/develop/agent-drive-ux-setup/docs/ux-walker/setup-nov27/stories/PROD-02/screenshots/step-2-full.png
F-PROD-01-1.suggested_fix: Make the landing table match /pricing (or the reverse).

F-PROD-01-2.description: Hero and quickstart describe the pairing step differently from llms.txt and Connect an agent. Hero says 'Your agent shows a pairing code, and you approve it'; quickstart step 3 says 'check that the code matches ... and click Approve'. llms.txt and /docs/connect-an-agent require typing a separate 'Verification code' into the page.
F-PROD-01-2.expected: Every surface mentions the verification code the human must type.
F-PROD-01-2.actual: A human who reads only the hero or quickstart is told about one code, then meets a required second field on /connect.
F-PROD-01-2.evidence: Hero text in /Users/dennison/develop/agent-drive-ux-setup/docs/ux-walker/setup-nov27/stories/PROD-01/screenshots/step-1.png; quickstart text 'The CLI prints a link and a code. Open the link while signed in, check that the code matches the one in the terminal, and click Approve.'; connect-an-agent text 'types the verification code into the page'
F-PROD-01-2.suggested_fix: Add 'and type the verification code the agent prints' to the hero hint and quickstart step 3.

F-PROD-01-3.description: Quickstart step 4 is written to the agent, not the human reader ('Offer these choices in this order and let the person pick one'), on a page whose intro says 'This page walks you through'. Step 1 'Sign up' also conflicts with the agent path in llms.txt, where sign-up is not a step.
F-PROD-01-3.actual: Mixed audience: human checklist with agent-directed wording.
F-PROD-01-3.suggested_fix: Reword step 4 for the human ('Choose one backup option') and note that sign-up can also happen when the approval link asks for sign-in.

F-PROD-01-4.description: The macOS Finder app is not discoverable. Landing, footer, docs index, sidebar and llms.txt never mention it. /desktop, /download, /finder, /mac, /docs/mount, /docs/desktop, /docs/finder all return 404. The only download link (GitHub release zip 'Agent Drive Finder 0.3.1') is inside two paragraphs of the 48 KB CLI reference.
F-PROD-01-4.expected: A visitor who wants Finder access finds a page and a download from the nav or docs index.
F-PROD-01-4.actual: Only reachable by reading the CLI reference 'Install and configuration' and 'macOS requirements and unmounting' sections.
F-PROD-01-4.evidence: curl status 404 for the listed paths; href https://github.com/dennisonbertram/agent-drive/releases/download/finder-v0.3.1/Agent-Drive-Finder-0.3.1.zip; /Users/dennison/develop/agent-drive-ux-setup/docs/ux-walker/setup-nov27/stories/PROD-05/screenshots/step-1-cli-macos.png
F-PROD-01-4.suggested_fix: Add a docs page 'Finder and mounts' to the docs index and link it from the landing page.

F-PROD-01-5.description: The CLI reference contradicts itself on whether the Finder app is signed. One sentence says 'the separate signed Agent Drive app' and 'signed Agent Drive.app'; the next says the macOS builder workflow 'compiles the app but does not sign, notarize, or publish it'. A new user cannot tell whether macOS will warn about an unidentified developer.
F-PROD-01-5.expected: One clear statement of signing and notarization state, with what the user will see on first open.
F-PROD-01-5.actual: Both claims appear within the same paragraph.
F-PROD-01-5.evidence: /docs/cli paragraph beginning 'The Linux npm package includes native mount helpers'; /Users/dennison/develop/agent-drive-ux-setup/docs/ux-walker/setup-nov27/stories/PROD-05/screenshots/step-1-cli-macos.png
F-PROD-01-5.suggested_fix: State whether Agent Drive-Finder-0.3.1.zip is signed and notarized; separate that from the source-build workflow.

F-PROD-01-6.description: The hero terminal option shows `npm install -g @dennisonbertram/agent-drive` with no Node 24 requirement and no next command (`agent-drive login`). Node 24 is stated only in quickstart, llms.txt and the CLI docs.
F-PROD-01-6.expected: Hero tells a terminal user the Node requirement and what to run next.
F-PROD-01-6.actual: A user on Node 20 runs the copied command and gets an unexplained engine failure; the npm package declares engines >=24.0.0.
F-PROD-01-6.suggested_fix: Add 'Node 24+' and a link to the quickstart next to the hero command.

F-PROD-01-7.description: The two hero copy controls look unrelated: 'Copy prompt' is a sentence-case white outlined button inside the dark panel, 'COPY COMMAND' is a small uppercase monospace outlined box beside the command.

F-PROD-01-8.description: Signed-out 'Choose Developer' (from /pricing) goes to /console/billing then /sign-in?redirect_url=https://agentdrive.xyz/console/billing. The return path is kept (good), but the form says 'Welcome back! Please sign in to continue' with no mention of billing or plans, and a new visitor sees 'Welcome back'.
F-PROD-01-8.expected: Context line such as 'Sign in to choose a plan' and a visible sign-up path for new visitors.
F-PROD-01-8.actual: Generic sign-in; the sign-up route is a small link under the card.
F-PROD-01-8.suggested_fix: Show context from redirect_url and say 'New here? Create an account' prominently.

F-PROD-01-9.description: Bare /connect while signed out shows the ordinary sign-in form with no explanation that this is the agent approval page or that the agent's code is needed afterwards. The signed-in bare /connect (code entry) was not walked.
F-PROD-01-9.expected: Heading or line such as 'Sign in to connect an agent'.
F-PROD-01-9.actual: Identical to /sign-in; only the header links carry redirect_url=%2Fconnect.
F-PROD-01-9.suggested_fix: Add a context line on sign-in when redirect_url is /connect.

F-PROD-01-10.description: 'Agent setup guide' (footer, docs index 'For agents') opens /llms.txt as plain monospace text that starts with a 50-line docs index; the setup steps start further down. A human following that link to understand setup sees a link list first.
F-PROD-01-10.expected: Setup steps first, or a short pointer to them.
F-PROD-01-10.actual: Index first, '## Set up (local agent with a shell)' below the first screen.
F-PROD-01-10.suggested_fix: Move the setup section above the doc index, or name the link 'Agent instructions (plain text)'.

F-PROD-01-11.description: Sign-up and sign-in repeat the alternative-route link three times: header 'Sign in', card footer 'Already have an account? Sign in', and the line below the card 'Already have an account? Sign in · Pricing · Docs'.
F-PROD-01-11.actual: Three links to the same destination on one screen.
F-PROD-01-11.suggested_fix: Remove the line below the card or keep only the Clerk footer.
